offering_description.value: Designs and sells smart cutting and crafting machines, plus blades, mats, vinyl and iron-on materials, and a design software subscription. Sold mainly to hobbyists and small crafters, who cut and decorate their own projects using the company's software and materials.

primary_products.value: smart cutting machines; blades and cutting tools; cutting mats; vinyl and iron-on materials; pens and accessories

primary_services.value: design software subscription; ready-to-make project content

customer_segment.value: B2C: hobbyists, DIY crafters, parents and gift makers; B2B: small business owners who make and sell custom goods

end_markets.value: arts and crafts; home decor; gifts and personalization; small business

revenue_model.value: product sales: cutting machines, tools, blades, mats and materials sold through retail and online; subscription: Cricut Access membership for design content, fonts and images

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs machines and materials made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers; software / platform: Design Space software and content library, sold to users by subscription and free access

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Europe, Australia, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: cutting machines, blades and materials, and the Cricut Access subscription, all sold to the same crafting customers

distribution_channels.value: online: cricut.com and major online marketplaces; third-party retail: big-box, craft and electronics retailers such as Walmart, Target, Michaels and Best Buy

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal consumer product safety and electronics rules for powered devices and consumer products
